name: firmware-ci
description: Replays the CI job that builds handheld firmware with act in its own containers, then checks the image fits its region and can wake from deep sleep.
lenses: the green tick on a masked failure
the OTA slot after next year's features
the wake pin the board routed
the hang with no reset path
origin: written from three faults in a battery handheld's firmware: its CI had never built it, its board definition's flash layout disagreed with the bootloader, and its deep sleep had no wake source. Its controls are the pack's own ESP-IDF app; no project's design came with it.
